body.purpose: Buttons, settings rows, menus, and primary UI labels.

label.purpose: Status bar, details, metadata, and chips.

editor.purpose: Note content and all cursor/selection measurement.

motion.name: state-fast

components.name: Command Button
components.description: Compact bordered command button for toolbar, menu, and dialog actions.
components.css: .ds-command-button { height: 30px; min-width: 64px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #303848; background: #1d2430; color: #d7dae0; font: 500 13px/1.35 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-command-button:hover { background: #303848; } .ds-command-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2f7; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-command-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Primary Apply Button
components.description: Accent action for applying themes or confirming important changes.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { height: 30px; min-width: 68px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #7aa2f7; background: #7aa2f7; color: #0f1117; font: 600 13px/1.35 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-button:hover { background: #c678dd; border-color: #c678dd; } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7dae0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Toggle Row
components.description: Settings row with title, detail text, and native-feeling switch.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { min-height: 54px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(48,56,72,.45); background: #0f1117; color: #d7dae0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle-row:hover { background: #161922; } .ds-toggle-row strong { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-toggle-row span { display: block; color: #7f8490; font-size: 11px; } .ds-toggle { width: 38px; height: 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #7aa2f7; padding: 2px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-toggle > span { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: #0f1117; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2f7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Theme Library Row
components.description: Theme manager list row with preview state, variant badge, author, and actions.
components.css: .ds-theme-row { min-height: 64px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(48,56,72,.45); background: #0f1117; color: #d7dae0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 10px 0 12px; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-theme-row:hover { background: #161922; border-color: #7aa2f7; } .ds-theme-row i { width: 5px; height: 40px; border-radius: 3px; background: #98c379; } .ds-theme-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-theme-main strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-theme-main span { color: #7f8490; font-size: 11px; } .ds-theme-main b { background: #161922; border: 1px solid rgba(48,56,72,.45); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 8px; margin-right: 8px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-theme-row em { color: #98c379; font-size: 12px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; } .ds-theme-row button { height: 30px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #303848; background: #161922; color: #7f8490; padding: 0 10px; } .ds-theme-row .ds-apply { border-color: #7aa2f7; background: #7aa2f7; color: #0f1117; } .ds-theme-row button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2f7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Settings Sidebar Item
components.description: Compact settings navigation item with tonal active state and internal indicator.
components.css: .ds-settings-nav { width: 176px; height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #7f8490; font: 500 13px/1.35 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-settings-nav span { width: 3px; height: 16px; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; } .ds-settings-nav:hover { background: rgba(48,56,72,.35); } .ds-settings-nav.active { background: rgba(48,56,72,.55); color: #d7dae0; font-weight: 700; } .ds-settings-nav.active span { background: #d7dae0; } .ds-settings-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa2f7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editor Cursor
components.description: Translucent Vim block cursor over mono editor text.
components.css: .ds-editor-line { position: relative; width: 360px; padding: 12px; background: #0f1117; color: #d7dae0; font: 400 14px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-editor-line b { position: absolute; left: 176px; top: 12px; width: 9px; height: 20px; border-radius: 0; background: rgba(215,218,224,.45); animation: ds-cursor-blink 1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-cursor-blink { 50% { opacity: .2; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-editor-line b { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
NeoNote is a native Windows work surface for text: calm enough for long writing sessions, precise enough for Vim-style editing, and polished enough to feel like a finished productivity app. The system should feel tactile and native, with controls that respond immediately and surfaces that sit naturally inside a Windows desktop environment.

The interface is restrained because the editor owns the experience. Chrome, tabs, settings, status text, and theme controls should support writing without becoming a dashboard. NeoNote rejects Electron, WebView, web dashboard, browser-based editor, developer-tool prototype, heavy Obsidian-style vault, Neovide particle-effects clone, and generic SaaS interface patterns.
keyCharacteristics: Native Windows productivity feel, not web-app decoration.
Dark and light theme support through the same semantic theme tokens.
Dense but readable controls built around 13px labels and a 14px mono editor.
Subtle motion for state feedback, never page choreography.
Dialogs and popups use native lifted elevation; editor and chrome stay mostly flat.

rules.name: The Existing Themes Rule
rules.body: New UI must consume `theme-background`, `theme-background-alt`, `theme-surface`, `theme-border`, `theme-text`, `theme-text-muted`, and semantic accent tokens. Never hardcode a one-off palette into active UI.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Accent color is for current state, primary action, cursor/search affordances, and mode information. Do not use it as general decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and error colors are state colors. They must not become category colors, badges, or visual confetti.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: NeoNote is a working editor, not a landing page. Large marketing typography is forbidden inside the product surface.

rules.name: The Mono Precision Rule
rules.body: Text editing, cursor measurement, and selection rendering must stay anchored to the configured monospace editor font.

rules.name: The Native Lift Rule
rules.body: Resting chrome is flat or tonal. Only popups and dialogs lift.

rules.name: The No Ghost Card Rule
rules.body: Do not pair decorative wide soft shadows with bordered card grids. NeoNote uses borders for structure and shadows for actual transient elevation.

dos: Do preserve existing themes by styling through semantic theme tokens, not direct palette values.
Do keep the editor content first; chrome should be quiet, compact, and supportive.
Do use Native lifted elevation for dialogs and popups only.
Do keep motion purposeful: hover, dialog open/close, tab transitions, cursor glide, smooth scroll, and theme transitions.
Do verify muted text contrast across both dark and light built-in themes.
Do keep controls keyboard-accessible with visible focus states.
Do treat Vim mode colors as state feedback.
donts: Don't make NeoNote look like an Electron, WebView, web dashboard, or browser-based editor.
Don't ship developer-tool prototype spacing, inconsistent controls, or unpolished dialog surfaces.
Don't add heavy Obsidian-style vault, workspace, plugin system, file explorer, Markdown preview, or split-pane knowledge base UI.
Don't add Neovide particle effects, sparkles, ripples, GPU-heavy cursor effects, or distracting motion.
Don't use generic SaaS interface patterns such as overdesigned cards, decorative gradients, or web-first interaction patterns.
Don't use side-stripe card accents. A narrow active indicator inside navigation is allowed; colored border-left decoration on content cards is not.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism as a default material, or hero-metric templates.
Don't animate layout in ways that make typing, cursor movement, or scrolling feel delayed.
